newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks down 1.01 pct on rate hikes.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks down 1.01 pct on rate hikes.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were down in afternoon trading on Tuesday following the central bank's move to raise the rates for bilateral central bank certificates (SBIs) of maturities betweek one-week to three-months, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was down 6.06 points, or 1.01 percent, at 593.57 points at 0705 GMT. Decliners led advancers by 68 to 49 with 46 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 364 billion rupiah.

Banking stocks were the hardest hit following the central bank's move, with blue-chips Bank Negara Indonesia, Bank Internasional Indonesia and BDNI among the losers on expected high cost of funds, brokers said.
